name: arya-vocal
notes: Audition variant of the user-approved custom-2, for stock pads. Brings vocal presence forward with 2 dB more around 2 kHz while retaining its bass filters and 4-5 kHz cuts. Can sound shoutier on some recordings; this is a preference experiment. Raw device Q; the 2 kHz Q is adjusted to retain approximately the baseline bandwidth. All five arya audition presets use -11.5 dB preamp, 1.5 dB below custom-2; equal preamp is not perceptual loudness matching. Modeled headroom only; not acoustically verified or auditioned.
